```{r}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(
  paths = "/fsb/directory/",
  domain = "miamioh.edu",
  bot = "*"

```

```{r}
dept_names = c('Accountancy', 'Economics', 'Entrepreneurship', 'Finance',
               'Information%20Systems%20%26%20Analytics', 'Marketing', 'Management')

directory_df = data.frame()
for (abbrv in dept_names) {
  cat( rep("-", 50) , "\n")
  print(abbrv)
  directory_url = paste0(
    'https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/', abbrv, '/all'
  )
  
  webpage = rvest::read_html(directory_url)
  
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:last-child strong a") -> name_links
  name_links |> rvest::html_text2() -> faculty_name
  name_links |> rvest::html_attr("href") -> faculty_website
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:last-child i") |> rvest::html_text2() -> faculty_position

    df = data.frame(department = abbrv, faculty_name = faculty_name, faculty_position = faculty_position, faculty_website = faculty_website)
  print(df$title[1:2])
  directory_df = rbind(directory_df, df)
  
  Sys.sleep(1)
}

head(directory_df)
```
